explanation: Fires only at D1, and only when the previous trial was unrewarded and it is early in the episode (roughly the first 25 trials): usually 8-10, especially after an unrewarded common transition or a run of losses, and it stays high across consecutive losses. Every GO and D2 step is 0, D1 after a reward is 0 (at most 2-4 right after a loss spike), and after trial 30 it is almost always 0 even after losses (rarely 2-4).
